about: Slayer Legend Soul Weapon engraving patterns, by weapon (id: the weapon's place in the game's order, stage = 320 + 20 x (id - 13)). cells: [row, col] of the grid's active cells, row 0 at the top; grid: 4 (4x4) or 5 (5x5), null without engraving. variants: complete fillings from the user's sheet (source user-sheet), each piece with its shape, rotation (quarter turns clockwise), cells and the sheet's colour label (it tells pieces apart, it is not a piece property). gold: the most 1x4 bars the pattern holds (count, bars), and balanced: a complete filling with the most bars one can hold (bars; max: the count above) and its other pieces closest to the Balanced variant's shapes, null when no complete filling exists; with or without rotation (vertical bars only), computed when this file was built. completion: ATK % and HP % once every cell is filled, from the wiki. wiki_check: whether the wiki's grid (from screenshots, or players' submissions) has the same cells. tileable_*: some multiset of the shapes fills the pattern exactly. rotation: whether the game turns pieces (null: not confirmed); pieces are never mirrored. shapes and their stat: as the wiki gives them. Nothing is checked in game yet (verified_in_game).

source.primary: the user's sheet of engraving solutions (user-sheet), read from its pixels
